body:
## Summary
- **Shift+drag send** adjusts aux InternalSend pan azimuth (0=L…1=R). Level drag unchanged; **P** badge + knob when panner present.
- `--smoke-send-pan`: L → R → C on Audio1→Aux, Dummy exit 0.

## Test plan
- [x] `win_ardour\run-engine-shell.bat --timeout 3 --backend Dummy --smoke-send-pan` → exit 0

Modern D2D + thin Cairo; no gtkmm2; WASAPI shared.
title: Expose aux send pan azimuth (Shift+drag send)
